message: 仁義エクステンド

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sweets Club emergency!! Help me, Synn-kun!」

name: Synn
message: 「What happened?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan and Yumil had a fight, and it's a total disaster!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaat. Why?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Because Nana-chan wants quality over quantity, and Yumil says quantity over quality!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm... For once, I might have to side with Okamoto-san.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I don't really care either way, though! Still, if things keep going like this, Nana-chan's tyranny as president is gonna get even worse!」

name: Synn
message: 「Pretty immature of her to act like that toward an underclassman. Why don't you just become president instead, Sacchin?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Me!? That might actually be a great idea!」

name: Synn
message: 「For starters, maybe try imitating Nanaka.」
After making the rounds at all the cake shops in the shopping district, we place a takeout order at Sans Souci in the residential area.

name: Sacchin
message: 「What do you want to eat, Synn-kun?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh? Oh, you don't have to do that.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's fine, it's fine! Think of it as a thank-you for carrying my bags!」

name: Synn
message: 「O-Oh... Thanks. Then, cheesecake.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Got it~♪」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Apparently the manager of Sans Souci is friends with my dad! That's why we can get a discount!」
Friends with that intimidating clerk...?

name: Sacchin
message: 「Alright! Sweets, complete~♪」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-Yeah!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well then, time to dig in!」
Under the blue sky, Sacchin's taste-testing session begins.

name: Synn
message: 「Now then, what's the score!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Mmmmm. This is, without a doubt...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「100 points!」

name: Synn
message: 「How about this one!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「100 points!」

name: Synn
message: 「How about this one!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hmm, it's bitter. 0 points!」

name: Paqy
message: 「That's almost entirely subjective」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Even if you say that, I can only pick whether I like it or hate it」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Sigh... Nana-chan really is amazing after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, Nanaka's got her whole life riding on it」

name: Sacchin
message: 「She really ought to bet her life on something more important, though」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you mean?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I might not be able to evaluate sweets, but I won't lose to anyone when it comes to evaluating love」
Bottomless cheerfulness. Just being around Sacchin, who's positive about everything, perks me up too.

name: Synn
message: 「Alright. Then I'll... dig in!」

name: Synn
message: 「Munch, munch... Delicious!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Good grief, Synn-sama is on the exact same level」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Heehee, you only ever say 'delicious'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, there they are! Hey, Sacchiiin!」
From afar, Nanaka and Okamoto-san come jogging over.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Huh? What happened to you two fighting?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, when the portions are too small, you can't even tell the flavor, let alone the quality」

name: Yumil
message: 「I ate a ton of nasty stuff and had a rough time, sir」
Both of them hate to lose in more ways than one.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Anyway, I'm just glad you two are back on good terms」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright. Then let's stop by Sans Souci to celebrate!」

name: Yumil
message: 「I'm all for it」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin, didn't you just finish eating a cake from Sans Souci……」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hehehe, there's always room for sweets, you know♪」
The members of the Sweets Club headed off in high spirits to eat some sweets.
Sometimes I wonder.
Isn't Sacchin actually the reason the Sweets Club manages to stay together as a group?

name: Helena
message: 「Indeed. Never forget that behind every operation, there is an unsung hero.」

name: Synn
message: 「Helena-san!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Sacchin's actions embody the spirit of chivalry…… As Student Council President, I've learned something valuable today.」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huh…… I have no idea what you're talking about, though」

name: Helena
message: 「And so, I present you with this trophy♪」
W-Why the yakuza code of honor……?
